name: Outdoor Prefabricated Integrated Cooling Station AIS
full_description: The AIS prefabricated integrated cooling plant integrates chillers, plate heat exchangers, pumps, cooling towers, valves, control systems, and ancillary components into a factory-manufactured and pre-assembled outdoor cooling station. Accessen states that the system reduces on-site construction complexity, eliminates the need for a dedicated plant room, and enables rapid commissioning once water and electrical connections are completed.

details.title: What is integrated inside the AIS station?
details.content: Accessen describes the AIS as an integrated outdoor cooling station that combines chillers, plate heat exchangers, pumps, cooling towers, valves, intelligent controls, and supporting components into a factory-preassembled package.

details.title: Why is it suitable for fast-track projects?
details.content: Because the modules are preassembled in the factory and only require site foundation preparation plus water and electrical connections, the AIS helps shorten on-site construction and commissioning time.
